site_name: Second Floor Flat D, 25 Crescent Road, Hornsey, London, N8 8AL
description:
Replacement of 5 existing double-glazed aluminium casement windows with double-glazed white PVC-U casement windows of the same style, size and configuration. The windows are located at second floor level within a flat at 25D Crescent Road, London N8 8AL, which is situated within a conservation area. The existing windows are non-original aluminium units in poor condition — several are blown, warped and no longer close properly. 

The proposed replacement windows match the existing units in style and configuration, with no change to the size or arrangement of any window openings and no alteration to the external appearance of the building. All units will be white-framed double-glazed casements with 25mm Georgian bar inserts, A-rated, with trickle vents fitted in compliance with Building Regulations (Approved Document F). Work to be carried out by Anglian Home Improvements (FENSA registered, Order No. 30497601).
